name: Moon-Touched Weapons
description: The creature’s weapon attacks are magical. When the creature hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4 (1d8) radiant damage (included in the attack). A creature that takes radiant damage from a creature’s weapon sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius for 1 hour.
